prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: wrist fracture. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1306; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision on [LOSS_DATE]. On that date, your insured changed lanes without checking his blind spot and sideswiped our client's vehicle, forcing it toward the shoulder. The police report confirms that your insured failed to yield the right of way, and an independent witness has provided a statement supporting our client's account of the events.

As a result of the impact, our client suffered a fractured wrist that required immediate medical treatment, immobilization, and a course of physical therapy. Our client has been unable to work full duty during recovery and continues to experience pain, reduced grip strength, and limited range of motion. Medical records and billing statements documenting treatment to date are enclosed.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured's negligence caused the collision and our client's resulting injuries. We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
